name: instant-worker — flow_test P0 fail [a P0 user flow broken in prod]
description: P0 page on ANY occurrence of instant_flow_test_total{result="fail"} for a P0 flow. The continuous-monitoring synthetic runner (worker/internal/jobs/flow_synthetic.go) runs the P0 flow matrix against prod every 5 min: flow="healthz" (anon GET /healthz), flow="auth_me" (authenticated GET /auth/me with a minted session JWT), flow="provision_reap" (POST /db/new → DELETE /api/v1/resources/:id round-trip). A fail means one of those user flows is broken in production. FACET by flow so the responder sees which matrix cell went red. Cross-correlate: read the failing InstantFlowTest custom event's commitId attribute and compare to /healthz .commit_id to name the deploy that introduced the red (rule 14/15); the audit_log row (kind=flow_test_failed, actor='system:flow_synthetic') and the slog ERROR line flow_test_failed flow=... reason=... carry the same content. The whole synthetic layer is INERT until the operator sets FLOW_SYNTHETIC_ENABLED=true, so this never fires before enablement. Threshold ABOVE 0 over a 10m window = two consecutive 5-min ticks of fail (unambiguous regression, not flake). Source: worker/internal/jobs/flow_synthetic.go, metric registered in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go (FlowTestTotal).

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_flow_test_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'instant_flow_test_total' AND result = 'fail' FACET flow
